name: Coastal Electronics, LLC
old_description: is a woman-owned small business located in Westerly, Rhode Island. We named our company in honor of the beautiful ocean scenery surrounding our area.
about:
Coastal Electronics, LLC is a woman-owned small business based in Westerly, Rhode Island. The company took its name from the ocean scenery that surrounds the area.

The firm operates as a distributor and supply-chain service provider, specializing in electronic components, fasteners, cabling, connectors, and sockets. It purchases directly from manufacturers such as Mill-Max, GE Fanuc, Samtec, and Amontec, and maintains access to surplus inventory from OEMs and contract electronics manufacturers. Services include piece-count quality control, counterfeit-part guarantees, third-party testing and certification, surplus-inventory advertising and physical inventory, immediate RFQ response, stocking programs with blanket-order support, and consolidated billing and shipping with sub-packaging for clear identification.

Customers include original equipment manufacturers, contract electronics manufacturers, and government contractors seeking hard-to-find parts or proposal pricing. The company also sources non-electronic items such as furniture, racking, paints, and chemicals, drop-shipped directly from manufacturers.

Coastal Electronics emphasizes a hands-on approach: every part is piece-counted rather than weighed, counterfeit parts are guaranteed against, and the team works directly with buyers and engineers to develop quotes for government bids. Consolidated invoicing and coordinated receiving support are offered to reduce administrative burden.
